description: Send a plain-text email from a connected mailbox (copy saved in Sent; up to 20 recipients). Up to 20 files: pass a public https link as source_url (cheapest: the server downloads it), a small file as content_base64 (700 KB), or an Object Storage file (service_id, region, bucket, key). Files are attached up to 35 MB; bigger ones go out as download links at the end of the email. To reply, pass reply_to_message_id. Needs confirm: true after the customer approves recipients, subject and text.

content_base64.description: The file itself, base64 (small files only).

delivery.description: auto (default): attach if it fits in 35 MB, otherwise a download link. link: always a download link. attach: attach or fail.

filename.description: Name shown to the recipient (defaults to the storage file name).

key.description: Storage file to send instead of content_base64.

link_hours.description: How long a download link works (default 168 = 7 days).

service_id.description: Object Storage service id (for a storage file).

source_url.description: Public https link to the file (e.g. a chat attachment link). Downloaded and attached up to 35 MB; bigger files are sent as this link.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the customer has explicitly confirmed this exact change.

email.description: Mailbox address on one of the customer's own domains, e.g. info@example.com.

name: mail_send
title: Send an email
